stem.text: A string is fixed at one end and the other end is attached to a vibrator. The frequency of the vibrator is slowly increased from zero. A series of stationary waves is formed. Assume that for a stationary wave there is a node at point P.

stem.alt: Diagram of a string with one end attached to a box labelled vibrator and the other end at a hatched wall labelled fixed; point P is marked near the vibrator end, and the length between P and the wall is labelled L.

stem.text: What are the first five wavelengths of the stationary waves that could be formed?
